exit_gate: Launch path unreachable unless ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 AND ALLOW_WRITES=1 AND all of write_gate_parity, runner_topic_allowlist, audit_log, collision_guard_preflight, dry_run_default, cwd_process_sandbox_pin, concurrency_cap pass; blocked attempts audited; rollback = unset ALLOW_LAUNCH restores disabled default.
title: Gated enablement (only phase that can ever launch)

requirement: A launch requires GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 AND GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=1; both default '0'. Mirrors core.writes_allowed() / run_taskctl write-gate exactly.
Only runner/topic pairs on an explicit static allowlist may be launched; any unknown or off-topic pair is blocked and audited.
Every launch, plan, and blocked attempt appends one entry to the append-only audit.jsonl (reuse core.write_audit_entry); env values/secrets are never logged.
taskctl collision-guard must pass immediately before a launch is permitted; any stale/conflicting claim blocks the launch.
Plan-only (dry-run) is the default action; a real launch requires an explicit opt-in argument beyond the gate flags, never the default code path.
Any launched process has cwd pinned to GEOAI_REPO, a scrubbed env (no secret vars), argv-list only (no shell=True), and bounded timeout; no arbitrary command execution.
A small concurrency cap (default 1) limits simultaneously launched agents; exceeding the cap blocks new launches to protect the workstation and the shared task queue.
